analysis.summary: Game Changers Texfab Limited reported its audited financial results and investor presentation for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. Management highlighted record performance with highest ever sales and PAT in FY26, driven by retail expansion, product diversification, and operational efficiencies. The company outlined aggressive growth targets of 30%-35% revenue CAGR and 40%-45% PAT CAGR over the next 3 years, along with plans for main board listing in the pipeline within the next 3 years. Key strategic initiatives include expanding experience-led stores, leveraging AI-driven inventory tools, and scaling technical textiles and B2C segments. Game Changers Texfab Limited (TradeUNO) held its first earnings conference call as a public listed company on BSE for H1 FY26, reporting a 4.44% year-on-year revenue increase to Rs 57.23 crore and a 60% jump in PAT to Rs 8.31 crore.

guidance.claim: The company guides for a revenue growth CAGR of 30% and a PAT growth of 60% plus for the full year FY 2026.
guidance.quote: For the full year, our outlook for FY 2026 is to grow to at a CAGR of 30% in the terms of revenue and in terms of PAT about 60% plus.

guidance.claim: Projected revenue for FY 2026 is estimated between nearly 147 crore to 150 crore with a PAT of 18,00,00,000 to 20,00,00,000.
guidance.quote: This would translate to a projected revenue of nearly 147 crore to 150 crore and with the estimated path of 18,00,00,000 to 20,00,00,000.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that B2B customers increased from 1,161 to 1,282 and B2C customers from 50,000 to 53,000.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of B2B customers, we have added from 1,161 to 1,282 B2B customers and in B2C we have added from 50,000 to 53,000 customers.

demand_outlook.claim: The company added 2,000 plus new product choices to strengthen its portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: Also we have made our product portfolio strengthened by nearly 2000 plus new choice introductions.

demand_outlook.claim: The market potential for the proposed Lajpat Nagar store is 500 crores with 5 competitors operating there.
demand_outlook.quote: So as far as we have studied Lajpat Nagar, the market potential for our product, there is 500 crores and there are 5 competitors which are operating there.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is exploring markets including Lajpat Nagar, Chandigarh, Old Gurgaon, Dubai, and Bangladesh for store expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: So I first is that we would like to expand our stores for which we are exploring the following markets, which is Lajpat Nagar, Chandigarh, Old Gurgaon, Dubai and Bangladesh.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add about 10 experience centers over the next 2 1/2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: In total, over the next 2 1/2 years, we'll be adding about 10 experience centers.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects to finalize the Lajpat Nagar store rental deal next month and get possession in February.
capex_expansion.quote: So we are already in process of closing the Lajpat Nagar store rental deal and we are expecting by next month we'll finalize it and hopefully we'll get the possession of that store in February and we'll try to make it up and running by 25th March.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue for the first half of FY2026 was about 57.23 crore versus 55.1 crore last year, marking a 4.44% year on year growth.
margins_costs.quote: First half of the year FY2026, we did a revenue of about 57.23 crore in the first half of the year versus 55.1 crore last year which is a 4.44% year on year growth.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax jumped from nearly 5.18 crore to 8.31 crore, reflecting a 60% year on year increase.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly, the profit after tax, the PAT has jumped up from nearly 5.18 crore to 8.31 crore in current year vis-a-vis last year, which is a 60% year on year increase, which marks our focus on profitability rather than revenue.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded from 13.5% to 21.4% in the current year.
margins_costs.quote: Thirdly, EBITDA margin has expanded from 13.5% to 21.4% in current year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin increased from 9.4% last year to 14.5%.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT margin has increased from 9.4% last year to 14.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Key drivers for margin expansion include strong pricing power through solution-based selling, realizing sourcing discounts, and disciplined expense management.
margins_costs.quote: So the key drivers for us has been in margin expansion which denote strong pricing power through solution based selling, realizing sourcing discounts and disciplined expense management.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is in advanced stages with HDFC and Axis to increase its working capital limit from 9 1/2 crore to 25 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We are in advanced stages with HDFC and Access to increase this working capital limit from 9 1/2 crore to 25 crores which should happen in next 1 1/2 months.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to add about 10 experience centers over the next 2 1/2 years.
management_commitments.quote: In total, over the next 2 1/2 years, we'll be adding about 10 experience centers.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to increase B2C revenue percentage from 13-14% to 20 to 25% by 2028.
management_commitments.quote: It will take some time, but we feel that by 2028, when all these 10 experience centres are fully functional and firing, we will be able to achieve our vision.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to finalize the Lajpat Nagar store rental deal next month and get possession in February.
management_commitments.quote: So we are already in process of closing the Lajpat Nagar store rental deal and we are expecting by next month we'll finalize it and hopefully we'll get the possession of that store in February and we'll try to make it up and running by 25th March.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to increase working capital limits with HDFC and Axis in the next 1 1/2 months.
management_commitments.quote: We are in advanced stages with HDFC and Access to increase this working capital limit from 9 1/2 crore to 25 crores which should happen in next 1 1/2 months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
